title: Qin Wuyan and the giant ants
summary: Zhou Yixian and Xiao Huan travel on, bickering about money, while Ye Gou Daoren follows them; Xiao Huan is not worried because sister Ping'er gave her a weapon. At night in Fa Xiang's barrier, Lin Jingyu tells Fa Xiang that for ten years he has seen his village's massacre whenever he closes his eyes. Though Zhang Xiaofan is now the feared Vice Master of the Ghost King Sect, Lin Jingyu says he will always count him as his only friend, even if they must fight. Li Xun joins them, pursued by giant ants, and the group of Fa Xiang, Lin Jingyu, Zeng Shushu and Li Xun faces Qin Wuyan, who controls the ants. Fa Xiang urges Qin Wuyan to turn back from the wrong path, and Qin Wuyan asks why the righteous path is the only right one. Outmatched four against one, Qin Wuyan breaks off and flees, swearing to repay Gui Li for an attack, and Li Xun is left poisoned by the ants.
